# Glossary — English → Greek — [Business]

Save as content/glossary-el.md. Every product term with its agreed Greek
form, the forms to avoid, and grammatical notes. Grown by native review;
never by the model alone.

Formality: [εσείς / εσύ] everywhere, because [reason]. Imperatives in buttons
take [the plural / singular] form.

| English | Greek (agreed) | Avoid | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| booking | κράτηση | ραντεβού (unless medical) | Feminine. Plural: κρατήσεις. |
| book a call | κλείστε μια κλήση | κάντε κράτηση κλήσης | Button form, εσείς. |
| confirm | επιβεβαίωση (noun) / επιβεβαιώστε (button) | | |
| cancel | ακύρωση / ακυρώστε | | Destructive; pair with the thing cancelled. |
| sign in | σύνδεση / συνδεθείτε | είσοδος, login | |
| account | λογαριασμός | προφίλ (means profile) | |
| team | ομάδα | προσωπικό | Brand rule: "team", not "staff". |
